description: Department of Local Government - Northern Province - Notify convene the First Meeting of the Local Govt. Authorities of Janna MC and 29 Other Local Bodies
reasoning: This gazette content announces the scheduling of meetings for the election of Mayors/Chairmen and Deputy Mayors/Vice Chairmen for various Local Authorities in the Northern Province. It specifically deals with electoral processes at the local government level, including dates, times, and venues for these election meetings, which falls under the Elections category (Type 7) for electoral processes and related matters.
